cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: You Could at Least…
cards.instruction: Make the inconvenience visible enough that an apology becomes the easiest way forward.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I've put my wet sock beside your dinner. From your puddle.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Then you won't mind it sharing the table.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: An apology would dry the atmosphere considerably.

mechanism: A authorizes removal of a deliberately displayed inconvenience only in exchange for an apology, exercising rank over the path back to dinner.
confusable: D03 hides the offense; D27 makes the inconvenience conspicuous so apologizing is easier than tolerating the display.
comparison: The sock scene makes a wet item physically intrude on dinner; the timetable scene displays a documented sequence of lost time.
seedUse: Use D27-a wet sock and removal request, with S01 approval making the apology the condition for restoring normal dinner.
